## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused solution.

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks you ran, with their results.

## Screenshots

Include before/after images for meaningful UI changes. Use only synthetic or non-sensitive content. Write “Not applicable” for non-visual changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays browser-only and does not add image uploads, telemetry, remote logging, or runtime CDN assets.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, or I explained why it is not applicable.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused test coverage.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, screen-reader naming, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior were considered.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese copy remain complete and synchronized.
- [ ] `/pixelpeel/` asset paths and the static production build still work.
- [ ] User-facing changes are reflected in both READMEs and `CHANGELOG.md` where appropriate.
